Decane; Radiative Extinction; Flame Extinction; Microgravity Combustion; Diffusive Extinction; Multiple Droplet Combustion Apparatus; Droplet Combustion; Spacecraft Fire Safety; Ethanol; Soot Formation"},{"statement":"The independently varied parameters included fuel type, gas composition, pressure, droplet size, translation, and binary linear array spacing and size.","quote":"The independently varied experimental parameters during FLEX-2 experiments were 1) Fuel type 2) Ambient gas composition 3) Ambient Pressure 4) Droplet initial diameter 5) Droplet translation velocity (and acceleration) 6) Droplet spacing and initial size in a binary linear array."},{"statement":"The chamber atmosphere was controlled over pressures from 0.5 to 3.0 atm and oxygen mole fractions from 0.1 to 0.4 with diluent gas as the balance.","quote":"The chamber was filled with the appropriate atmosphere, which was varied in pressure between 0.5 atm to 3.0 atm and O2 concentration between 0.1 to 0.4 mole fraction with the diluent gas making up the balance."},{"statement":"Some tests dispensed a predetermined fuel amount onto a support fiber, while other droplets were freely deployed.","quote":"dispensing of a predetermined amount of fuel (based on the target droplet size) onto the support fiber for those tests in which the droplet is not freely deployed."},{"statement":"Flame evolution was monitored using high speed photography.","quote":"Monitor combustions and track flame evolution using high speed photography."}]}
